cohort: 300,085 singleton deliveries in the Nordic countries, including 39,919 after ART and 260,166 after SC
finding: Singleton pregnancies after ART are associated with higher risks of maternal and neonatal complications compared to SC pregnancies, but the impact of advanced maternal age (>35 years) appears more pronounced in SC pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in ART pregnancies than in SC pregnancies for most maternal ages.
